searchEvidenceNote: Scores combine current SERP intent inspection, existing site Search Console evidence where relevant, authoritative-source viability, network ownership and product judgment. NDBC nearby wave/wind/water-temperature observations and roughly three-hour change
NOAA CO-OPS high/low tide predictions where a valid tidal station exists

userQuestions: How much snow remains?

candidates.disposition: Production verified: canonical, API, Decision Desk integration, source lifecycle, live-source probes, full repository gate and public-origin Snow smoke all pass.

sourceFamilies: NOAA/NOHRSC provisional snow depth and SWE station reports
implementation.decisionRule: Measured pack farther than 60 miles is regional context only. Melt pressure is derived from nearby measured pack plus local NWS weather and never presented as an agency snowmelt forecast.

productionVerification.expectedPublicSmoke: Mount Hood OR, Burlington VT and Atlanta GA contract checks plus public Snow page shell
productionVerification.invariant: Any local melt/hold/refreeze/accumulation conclusion must be backed by measured pack within 60 miles.

userQuestions: When is the driest hiking window?

candidates.disposition: extend Garden rather than create a new canonical

candidates.disposition: deepen Night Sky; do not create a duplicate canonical

candidates.disposition: incorporate into Coastal; do not create a separate beach canonical initially

userQuestions: When is coastal visibility likely to improve?
candidates.competition: Niche intent; useful supporting signal but weak standalone demand.
candidates.disposition: Coastal enrichment only

userQuestions: When is solar exposure lower for outdoor work or walking?

candidates.disposition: support Garden/Outdoor Window/Coastal; no standalone family

userQuestions: Is river ice formation or breakup context available here?

candidates.disposition: do not generalize inferred river-ice condition; only add source-backed local context

userQuestions: When is pollen lower for outdoor activity?
candidates.competition: Strong consumer demand but no audited authoritative, sustainable national real-time source contract identified in this wave.
candidates.disposition: do not build in current architecture

userQuestions: Will I have a White Christmas?

candidates.competition: Most pages are static climatology maps or generic forecast articles; the product differentiates by progressively replacing the climatological prior with current-year evidence.
candidates.disposition: Build as a seasonal synthesis product off the production Snowpack platform; admit only map and Michigan supporting pages initially.

decision.canonicalRule: Rip-current, tide/current, freshwater-beach and coastal-visibility intents are lenses inside Coastal initially; do not fragment them into competing canonicals.
decision.longTailRule: No candidate authorizes location-page generation by score alone. White Christmas initially admits only the historical map and Michigan deep-dive; additional pages require distinct intent, primary-source depth and search evidence.
decision.nextStandaloneNote: Snowpack + Melt is production-verified. No additional new-product family currently clears both source and loss gates; Smoke/Clear-Air remains the highest-value blocked family.
